guidance.message: Within this prototype’s consumer-purchase scope; no legal result is guaranteed.
steps: Send a factual written grievance to the seller and preserve a copy.
If unresolved, contact the National Consumer Helpline at 1915 or its official portal.
For formal consumer commission filing, consult the current e-Jagriti guidance and assess deadlines/jurisdiction with a qualified professional.
